story.text: 해가 뉘엿뉘엿 지는 저녁, 동네 편의점의 환한 불빛이 골목을 밝히고 있었다.
story.reading: hae-ga nwi-yeot-nwi-yeot ji-neun jeo-nyeok, dong-ne pyeon-ui-jeom-ui hwan-han bul-bit-i gol-mok-eul balk-hi-go iss-eot-da.
story.en: As the sun set slowly in the evening, the bright lights of the neighborhood convenience store lit up the alley.

story.text: "여기가 바로 제 아지트예요, 아가씨." 규현이 자동문을 지나며 씩 웃었다. "편의점, 제대로 돌아본 적 없죠?"
story.reading: "yeo-gi-ga ba-ro je a-ji-teu-ye-yo, a-ga-ssi." gyu-hyeon-i ja-dong-mun-eul ji-na-myeo ssik us-eot-da. "pyeon-ui-jeom, je-dae-ro dol-a-bon jeok eop-jyo?"
story.en: "This right here is my hideout, miss." Kyuhyun grinned as he passed through the automatic doors. "You've never really explored a convenience store properly, have you?"

story.text: 그는 냉장 코너로 성큼성큼 걸어가더니 삼각김밥 하나를 집어 들었다. "이게 참치마요예요. 편의점 오면 일단 이것부터 먹어야 되는데."
story.reading: geu-neun naeng-jang ko-neo-ro seong-keum-seong-keum geol-eo-ga-deo-ni sam-gak-gim-bab ha-na-reul jib-eo deul-eot-da. "i-ge cham-chi-ma-yo-ye-yo. pyeon-ui-jeom o-myeon il-dan i-geot-bu-teo meog-eo-ya doe-neun-de."
story.en: He strode over to the refrigerated section and picked up a triangle-shaped rice ball. "This is tuna mayo. If you come to a convenience store, you've got to eat this first."

story.text: "자, 여기 이 노란 딱지 보이죠?" 그가 음료수 진열대의 스티커를 가리켰다. "이건 하나 사면 하나 더 주는 거예요. 이런 걸 놓치면 손해거든요."
story.reading: "ja, yeo-gi i no-ran ttak-ji bo-i-jyo?" geu-ga eum-nyo-su jin-yeol-dae-ui seu-ti-keo-reul ga-ri-kyeot-da. "i-geon ha-na sa-myeon ha-na deo ju-neun geo-ye-yo. i-reon geol not-chi-myeon son-hae-geo-deun-yo."
story.en: "See this yellow sticker here?" He pointed at a sticker on the drink shelf. "This means buy one, get one free. Missing a deal like this would be a real loss."

story.text: 계산대 앞에 서자 그가 슬쩍 귀띔했다. "이거 계산해 주세요, 하면 끝이에요. 어렵지 않죠?"
story.reading: gye-san-dae ap-e seo-ja geu-ga seul-jjeok gwi-ttim-haet-da. "i-geo gye-san-hae ju-se-yo, ha-myeon kkeut-i-e-yo. eo-ryeop-ji anh-jyo?"
story.en: As we stood at the register, he whispered a tip. "You just say, 'Please ring this up.' That's all there is to it. Not so hard, right?"

story.text: 직원이 물었다. "봉투 필요하세요?" 내가 우물쭈물하자 규현이 대신 대답했다. "괜찮아요, 저희 둘이 나눠 들면 되니까요." 하고는 나를 향해 눈을 찡긋했다.
story.reading: jig-won-i mul-eot-da. "bong-tu pil-yo-ha-se-yo?" nae-ga u-mul-jju-mul-ha-ja gyu-hyeon-i dae-sin dae-dab-haet-da. "gwaen-chan-a-yo, jeo-hui dul-i na-nwo deul-myeon doe-ni-kka-yo." ha-go-neun na-reul hyang-hae nun-eul jjing-geut-haet-da.
story.en: The clerk asked, "Do you need a bag?" As I hesitated, Kyuhyun answered for me. "No thanks, we'll just split it between the two of us." Then he winked at me.

story.text: 편의점 앞 파라솔 아래 나란히 앉아 삼각김밥을 나눠 먹는 동안, 밤바람이 선선하게 불어왔다. 그가 낮게 웃으며 중얼거렸다. "이런 게 은근히 재밌지 않아요?"
story.reading: pyeon-ui-jeom ap pa-ra-sol a-rae na-ran-hi anj-a sam-gak-gim-bab-eul na-nwo meong-neun dong-an, bam-ba-ram-i seon-seon-ha-ge bul-eo-wat-da. geu-ga nat-ge us-eu-myeo jung-eol-geo-ryeot-da. "i-reon ge eun-geun-hi jae-mit-ji anh-a-yo?"
story.en: Sitting side by side under the parasol outside the store, sharing the rice ball, a cool night breeze drifted by. He chuckled quietly. "Isn't this kind of thing secretly fun?"

words.example_en: I bought water at the convenience store.
Triangle gimbap is simple and delicious.
This ramen is on a buy-one-get-one promotion.
